name: Proxy Terminal
author: Sweepercom
credit: Proxy Terminal · a ZZZ-inspired profile for Sweepercom
description: A complete ZZZ-inspired game menu: acid-yellow player identity, native follow and options controls, Agents / About / Friends / Links screens, a cinematic character stage and slanted portrait roster. Uses your existing bot artwork.

components.name: Player profile & backdrop
components.blurb: A player-card header built around your real avatar, username, follower count and badges.

components.name: Janitor navigation & controls
components.blurb: Styles the native home, search, account, follow and options controls without replacing their behavior.

components.name: Game menu navigation
components.blurb: CSS-only Agents, About, Friends and Links screens. Keyboard and touch friendly; no script needed.

components.name: Agent select & roster
components.blurb: Large centered character art, a slanted portrait grid, selected contact information, tag filters and encounter links. Compatible with the Cards editor.

components.name: About, friends & social screens
components.blurb: Editable personal bio, creator notes, open friend slots and a Discord link. Empty slots are intentionally non-clickable until configured.

notes: Built against the bundled JanitorAI profile capture.
Hash links switch screens and agents; choosing an agent clears the tag filter.
The live site's native controls retain their own behavior; the offline preview does not submit actions.
All images are centered cover crops. No CSS image URLs, custom properties, scripts or form inputs.
